newsitem.title: USA: AutoZone Q4 same-store sales rise.
newsitem.headline: AutoZone Q4 same-store sales rise.

text.p: AutoZone Inc said fiscal fourth quarter sales increased 32 percent to $830 million from $629 million, while same store sales rose seven percent.
For the year, sales increased 24 percent to $2.24 billion from $1.81 billion in fiscal 1995, while same store sales increased six percent on a comparable-week basis.
Fiscal 1996 included 53 weeks, compared to 52 weeks in fiscal 1995.
AutoZone opened 125 new stores in the fourth quarter, a 49 percent increase over the 84 new stores opened in the prior year's fourth quarter.
For the year, the company opened 280 new stores, exceeding its goal of 257 stores.
